notes.title: Hell on Heaven Release Date and Notes
notes.content:
The Hell on Heaven Update will be releasing on June 1st.

[b]Details and Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]First half of Heaven Realm content including a new zone, new enemies and bosses
[*]2 new playable characters (Lust/Envy)
[*]5 new modifiers
[*]Updated in game player guides
[*]Multiple bug fixes
[*]Optimization mainly in Devildom and Outerlands tilesets of Hell
[*]Assist Mechanic
[/list]

[u][b]Assist Mechanic:[/b][/u]

Assist characters have a chance to spawn when encountering enemies, this chance increases with each wave of enemies and includes bosses.

[u]Assist Characters:[/u]
Faith: 
Grants the player a permanent attack boost.

Sloth: 
Creates a zone that heals the player over time.

Greed: 
Grants the player 3 free purchases from Greed's shop.

Megolo & Shilala:
Applies a burn (damage over time) and corrosive (attack damage reduction) debuff to all active enemies.

notes.title: QoL Update
notes.content:
[b]In this update the following changes have been made:[/b]

-Rain VFX has had an update
-Bug with water has been fixed (ie: water in nightmare bosses)
-Bug in tutorial has been fixed
-Added sigil burst to better show modifier downtime reset

[i]Up next expect to see some progress with the Hell on Heaven Arc's main and alter characters~[/i]

notes.title: Full Release Patch Notes
notes.content:
These are the changes to look forward to on Full Release:

[b]Finalized Night Heart System:[/b]
This system adds full night heart implementation, allowing them to be discovered mid-run at no cost, for more POWER. (This system was disabled in the demo to gain more feedback on boss balancing.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45168497/81ce108d60f2856307171dea1ce772271c59dae6.png[/img]

[b]Visual Modifiers:[/b]
Although this is simply a visual update, Modifiers will now show on the character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45168497/5e2f22629925f9c5e80b1561cd70155165f1c98a.png[/img]

[b]Training Mode:[/b]
In this training mode you will have access to all modifiers to test any combination on a group of mobs and a boss.

[b]Dialogue Adjustments:[/b]
Minor dialogue adjustments.

[b]Bug Fixes and Modifier Balancing:[/b]
Minor bug fixes and some modifiers were adjusted to be stronger.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Based off of well deserved feedback the following updates and alterations have been made, these changes have been made to improve combat clarity, and to assist with learning combat:


[b]HP Bars and a visible Armor Threshold:[/b]
HP Bars have now been included for normal enemies, while both normal enemies and bosses have an added visual component. This is a second bar underneath that displays what threshold the target's Armor is in. White is normal, Yellow is damaged, and Red is nearly broken.

[b]Combo List:[/b]
This combo list appears while executing attacks which also explains what each combo can be used for. Note that after the First Stage the combo list is removed.
[i](This change should help to learn and improve in the main focus of the game, combat)[/i]

[b]Lock On Changes:[/b]
Lock on has now been given a wider hitbox of double its size.
When locked on there is now a UI effect to let you know when you are locked on.

[b]Prologue Changes:[/b]
The prologue is now able to be repeated from the Main Menu.
[i](This was previously locked due to a bug)[/i]

There have also been slight UI changes to improve visual clarity.
